GlobalArchive.Hint: Inspect and restore deleted or replaced global playlists and folders.

ConflictMenu.Hint: Check local and global playlists or folders for matching IDs and keep both items if needed.

ConflictResolution.Name: ID conflict resolution
ConflictResolution.Hint:
Keep local: show the local item in this world and hide the global item with the same ID.
Keep both: give the local item a new ID, update its links, then show the global item.
Always ask: let the GM choose on entering the world.
Closing the dialog temporarily keeps the local item.

DuckStrength.Name: Audio ducking during preview
DuckStrength.Hint: 0% leaves other sounds unchanged. 100% silences music, environment, and interface sounds during preview.

SoundRowBudget.Name: Minimum displayed sounds
SoundRowBudget.Hint: The number of sound rows kept in the list across all expanded playlists. This increases automatically when a taller window needs more rows. A lower value reduces interface load but may update rows more often while scrolling. A higher value keeps more nearby rows ready but increases interface load.

Archive.Title: Global playlist archive
Archive.ReadOnlyUntilRepaired:
Storage did not load completely.
The archive is read-only until the data errors are resolved.
Archive.Intro: Select an archived snapshot to inspect or restore.
Archive.Missing: This sound exists in one version only.
Archive.SceneRelinkResultTitle: Some scene links were not updated
Archive.SceneRelinkPartial: The global item was restored. Links could not be updated in {count} scene(s):
Archive.BranchCount: This archived branch contains {folders} folder(s) and {playlists} playlist(s).
Archive.SnapshotKept: Restoring an item keeps this archived snapshot until you remove it manually.
Archive.RelinkScenes: Update {count} scene link(s) in this world to the restored playlist (if its ID changes)
Archive.SeparateWarning: Create a separate global item from this snapshot? The archived snapshot will remain available.
Archive.RestoreWarning: Restore this item as global? The archived snapshot will remain available.
Archive.ReplaceWarning:
Replace the current global item in all worlds with this snapshot?
The current version will be archived first.
Archive.ForgetWarning:
Remove this snapshot from archive.json?
It will no longer be available for restoration through the module.
Archive.ForgetBranchWarning:
Remove this folder and its archived branch from archive.json?
The branch will no longer be available for restoration through the module.
Archive.MoveConflictIntro: Local item “{name}” has the same ID as a global item.
Archive.MoveConflictEffect:
To continue the move, the local item will receive a new ID and its links in this world will be updated.
It will then become a separate global item.
Archive.NoConflicts: No local and global playlist or folder IDs conflict in this world.
Archive.ConflictIntro:
A local item and a global item have the same ID.
The local item remains available here. The global item remains saved and available in other worlds.
Archive.ConflictKeep: To keep both, the local item receives a new ID and its links in this world are updated.
